ownershipView.intro: The Nayar family controls Nykaa through six family trusts holding 52.1%, unchanged over the past year. Indian funds (24.1%) own almost twice as much as foreign investors (13.7%): SBI Contra Fund is the largest single fund holder at 4.2%.

ownershipView.read: **So what:** a stable, family-controlled register. The family's 52% means no takeover risk and long-term ownership, but also that minority shareholders depend on the family's judgement (four of eleven directors are Nayars). Domestic funds have been buying; foreign ownership rose from 11.6% (Jun-2025) to 13.7%.

industry.bpc: India BPC market ~$23bn in FY26, growing 12%+ a year to ~$42bn by FY31E; online ~20%+ a year (Redseer for Nykaa)
industry.fashion: Online fashion 22-25% a year to FY31E; premium online fashion ~3x by FY31 (Redseer for Nykaa)
industry.competition: Reliance's Tira, Myntra (beauty and fashion), Amazon, Purplle and quick-commerce apps (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes) selling mass beauty in 10-30 minutes. Nykaa's answers: Nykaa Now (60-minute delivery, 13 cities), premium and exclusive brands, stores.
